$comment: HorneroOS factory defaults: a fresh boot (or a fresh --dest materialize) lands on Hornero Signal Night in the Cockpit layout with no user setup and no network fetch. All values here are static files in this repo; nothing is cloned from ulises-jeremias/dotfiles at runtime (that repo is a read-only extraction source, see docs/DECISIONS.md).

compositor.note: Hornero Signal Night borders/groups (generated from the theme roles); shadow tint in hyprland.lua.d/static.lua decoration block.

integrations.name: Kitty
integrations.detail: GPU-accelerated, with the Kitty graphics protocol used by Yazi previews.
integrations.note: Every theme ships a generated <id>.conf palette; applying a theme switches the include line.

integrations.name: Alacritty
integrations.detail: A compact TOML configuration with live reload; Yazi image previews use the Wayland adapter through Überzug++ where configured.
integrations.note: The packaged night/day palettes and the applied-theme colour file are imported separately, so a theme apply never replaces your base config.

integrations.name: Ghostty
integrations.detail: A native Ghostty theme with a stable name that Hornero refreshes when a theme is applied.
integrations.note: A packaged system fallback (Signal Night) is available before Hornero writes the user-level theme palette.

terminal.note: Kitty is the Exo/default terminal. Alacritty and Ghostty are optional curated configurations; every terminal palette is rendered from the applied theme's schema-v2 roles.

paletteApplications.name: btop
paletteApplications.detail: A native btop theme rendered from the applied Hornero theme's Signal roles.
paletteApplications.note: btop remains an optional application; Hornero Config provides its defaults and theme when installed.

paletteApplications.name: Cava
paletteApplications.detail: A native Cava theme rendered from the applied Hornero theme's Signal roles.
paletteApplications.note: Cava remains an optional application; Hornero Config provides its defaults and theme when installed.

qt.note: Fusion + IBM Plex; per-theme colour schemes generated from schema-v2 roles, see docs/QT_DECISION.md.

gtk.note: Applied via desktop/gtk/settings.ini (generated from the default theme); recorded here so fresh-boot Signal Night is one contract.

fonts.note: RFC 0001 §3.3 families, shipped by ttf-ibm-plex (OFL-1.1). The shell bundles its own Hornero Glyphs icon font; no system icon font is required.

wallpaper.note: Procedural SVG source (assets/brand/wallpaper/hornero-signal-night.svg) is rendered at package staging to /usr/share/hornero/wallpapers/hornero-signal-night/. Wallpapers never recolour the UI.

shellLayout.note: RFC 0001 §5: Cockpit (top rail act, bottom strip know) is the factory layout; the preset payload is profiles/shell-presets/cockpit.json synced from HorneroOS/shell.
